fix: address multiple bugs in gemini agent

- Initialize global variables with safe defaults (None/[]/{})
- Remove restrictive API key prefix check (not all keys start with AIza)
- Add hasattr guard for response.function_calls (SDK version safety)
- Handle None response.text with fallback to empty string
- Add MAX_TOOL_LOOPS=5 limit to prevent infinite tool-calling loops
- Safely handle None call.args with dict(args) if args else {}
- Guard response.candidates[0] access against IndexError/None
- Return graceful message when max loop limit reached
